what_was_attempted: Determine a count from Mercedes Sosa’s discography table on English Wikipedia.
approach_taken: The agent issued one broad Wikipedia search for Mercedes Sosa’s English discography. After receiving mostly irrelevant results, it said it would narrow to the exact page but did not execute that follow-up or inspect the table.
where_it_went_wrong: The initial search returned no useful Mercedes Sosa discography page, and the agent failed to carry out its stated narrowing step, so it never obtained the data needed for the count.
